descriptions: Fixed: copSirens option had no real effect — DistantCopCarSirens only toggles ambient distant siren atmosphere which is off by default in GTA; replaced with a dedicated loop using SetVehicleHasMutedSirens per vehicle, running every 1s to catch newly spawned/streamed police vehicles
Added: sirens are properly restored (unmuted) when the copSirens option is disabled or the resource is stopped
Improved: UI tab switching now has a smooth slide + fade + blur animation (out-in transition)
